name: Eureka Springs
summary: A whole Victorian resort town clinging to the Ozark hillsides — steep winding streets, healing springs, and a famous glass chapel in the woods.

lodging.name: A Victorian Eureka Springs inn
lodging.blurb: A gingerbread hotel on the steep streets.

foodMustTry.name: Ozark trout & pie
foodMustTry.blurb: Mountain trout and a slice at a historic café.

days.label: Day 312 — The Victorian Ozarks
days.summary: Steep streets and a glass chapel.

item.title: Historic downtown & the springs
item.blurb: The entire downtown is on the National Register — winding streets, springs, galleries, and no traffic lights.

item.title: Thorncrown Chapel
item.blurb: A soaring 48-ft glass chapel with 425 windows, tucked into the Ozark woods — a modern architectural gem.

commute.scenicNote: West across the Ozarks to Bentonville.
